_source: Photographs of original works in the Grier Museum, sent by the project owner on 2026-10-21. Titles, artists and dates come only from what is inscribed or shown on each work; anything not visible is marked to be confirmed.
intro: Paintings and drawings in the collection of the Grier Museum and Library: portraits of notable Griersons, scenes of Grier House through the years, and original works by Griersons.

works.title: Victor Ludorum
works.description: A Grierson in a Grier House shirt holding the Victor Ludorum trophy, with a cricketer and a football team behind him. Subject and artist to be confirmed.

works.title: Grierson in Traditional Attire
works.description: Portrait in agbada and coral beads against a patterned background. Subject and artist to be confirmed.

works.file: 03 Grierson with the Mustard Seed and The Rock.jpg
works.title: With the Mustard Seed and The Rock
works.description: Portrait in front of a bookshelf holding the GCI Year Book, the Mustard Seed and The Rock, beside the Grier House crest with the motto Sapere Aude. Subject and artist to be confirmed.

works.title: Ekperigin '32, “Captain of all Games”
works.description: Harding Ekperigin of the 1932 set in his Government College blazer on the running track, inscribed “Captain of all Games”.

works.title: Ekperigin
works.description: Harding Ekperigin running barefoot in a Grier House vest.

works.title: Oba of Benin
works.description: Portrait in coral regalia before palace columns and Benin figures. Subject and artist to be confirmed.

works.title: Untitled
works.description: Figures with musical instruments drawn in pattern and line. Title and artist to be confirmed.

works.file: 08 Ink drawing of women with pots.jpg
works.title: Our culture is now
works.description: Women in patterned cloth with decorated pots.

works.title: New Grier House building donated by Wale Babalakin
works.description: The new Grier House building, completed in 2024, donated by Wale Babalakin.

works.title: Man of Nok
works.description: A head drawn in green on a red and yellow ground.

works.title: Head
works.description: A head with a blue headwrap on a patterned ground, signed “del ’06”.

works.title: Osolanke and the Princess of Ife
works.description: Overlapping faces built from line and pattern.

works.title: Grierson
works.description: A Grierson in white uniform, with students at work and a Grier House footballer behind him. Subject and artist to be confirmed.

works.title: Grier House, 1952
works.description: Grier House as it stood after its move in 1952 to the site near Field House. Artist to be confirmed.
